General Non-Existence Theorem for Phase Transitions in One-Dimensional Systems with Short Range Interactions, and Physical Examples of Such Transitions
pdfs.scope: Transfer-operator conditions delimit when one-dimensional short-range models have no phase transition. The exact hypotheses matter for finite-size and critical-size comparisons.

pdfs.title: Gaussian Processes for Machine Learning: Appendix A, Mathematical Background
pdfs.scope: This is the mathematical-background appendix, not the complete book. It supplies Gaussian conditioning and matrix identities used in exact elimination.

pdfs.title: Confinement of Quarks
pdfs.scope: The publisher scan contains the confinement article with adjacent-page material. It is background for lattice gauge observables, not a derivation of this program.

pdfs.title: Comparison Theorems for Gibbs Measures
pdfs.scope: Author-hosted version of the source also retrieved as arXiv:1308.4117.

pdfs.title: On Decompositions of Multivariate Functions
pdfs.scope: Author preprint with marked replacement/additional text; the displayed draft is not asserted to be the final journal edition. Used for anchored decomposition and interaction bookkeeping.

pdfs.title: Graphical Models, Exponential Families, and Variational Inference
pdfs.scope: Survey source for exponential families, normalization and variational duality; local correlated-recognition statements retain their separate derivations.

pdfs.title: Duality for Bregman Projections onto Translated Cones and Affine Subspaces
pdfs.scope: Studies Bregman projection duality under stated convex and differentiability assumptions. It does not make every finite inference update an exact projection.

pdfs.title: Borel Kernels and their Approximation, Categorically
pdfs.scope: Treats Borel kernels and approximation in categorical language. Used for normalized channel composition while retaining measurable-space hypotheses.

pdfs.title: Palm Theory, Mass-Transports and Ergodic Theory for Group-Stationary Processes
pdfs.scope: Doctoral dissertation on stationary random measures and group actions. It supports measure-theoretic context, not arbitrary all-point conditional coherence.

pdfs.title: The Existence and Uniqueness of the Haar Integral on a Locally Compact Topological Group
pdfs.scope: Provides Haar-measure construction for locally compact groups; noncompact Haar measure cannot be silently normalized into a probability law.

pdfs.title: Quasilinear Symmetric Hyperbolic Systems
pdfs.scope: Lecture notes develop well-posedness for quasilinear symmetric hyperbolic systems. The local Fisher-field construction must supply its own hypotheses and cannot infer global control from local existence.

pdfs.title: Lie Groups and Lie Algebras: MIT Lecture Notes
pdfs.scope: Course notes used for Lie actions and geometric background. No specific claim of new RG behavior follows from the reference alone.

pdfs.title: Group Actions on Manifolds
pdfs.scope: Lecture notes on actions, slices and quotients; regular quotient claims require the appropriate properness and freeness assumptions.

pdfs.title: A Cotangent Bundle Slice Theorem
pdfs.scope: Proves a cotangent-bundle slice result with specified action hypotheses. This is support for geometric local models rather than a general global gauge choice.

pdfs.title: Distributed Asynchronous Deterministic and Stochastic Gradient Optimization Algorithms
pdfs.scope: Analyzes distributed asynchronous gradient algorithms under explicit delay, stepsize and objective assumptions. The project checks its own weighted-block common-basin conditions.

pdfs.title: Distributed Asynchronous Computation of Fixed Points
pdfs.scope: Studies convergence of asynchronous fixed-point computation. Used as an algorithmic comparison, not as an automatic proof for arbitrary VFE updates.

pdfs.title: Some Aspects of Parallel and Distributed Iterative Algorithms: A Survey
pdfs.scope: Survey of parallel and asynchronous iteration; scheduler and convergence assumptions remain explicit in the program.

pdfs.title: The Cauchy-Kovalevskaya Theorem: MATH 580 Lecture Notes 2
pdfs.scope: Lecture notes on analytic local PDE existence and characteristic surfaces. Analytic local solvability does not imply stability or global field bounds.

pdfs.title: Information Theory: August 2024 Prepublication Version
pdfs.scope: Private downloaded prepublication text, marked personal use only. It supplies information-theoretic background; this vault does not redistribute the PDF.

pdfs.title: The Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Semigroup in Finite Dimension
pdfs.scope: Survey of nondegenerate finite-dimensional Ornstein-Uhlenbeck semigroups. Degenerate support and scale embedding require additional local analysis.

pdfs.title: Introduction to Smooth Manifolds: Chapter 1 Sample
pdfs.scope: Only the author-hosted first chapter was retrieved, not the complete textbook.

pdfs.title: Lectures on Algebraic Topology
pdfs.scope: Lecture notes dated August 27, 2021, based partly on notes by Sanath Devalapurkar. Used for topological background to bundles and obstructions.

pdfs.title: Intrinsic Methods in Filter Stability
pdfs.scope: Author-hosted survey of filter stability through conditional expectations and martingales. Retrieval alone does not identify a final publication year or supply a finite-memory rate for every hidden process.

pdfs.title: Completely Analytical Interactions: Constructive Description
pdfs.scope: Relates constructive conditions for complete analyticity of interactions. The program separately verifies its interaction norm and counting assumptions.

pdfs.title: Bundles, Homotopy, and Manifolds
pdfs.scope: Author-hosted notes on bundles and homotopy. The retrieved title pages do not establish a publication year; used as background rather than a new result.

pdfs.title: Information Theory and Statistics: A Tutorial
pdfs.scope: Tutorial on information-theoretic methods in statistics. It supports general entropy and divergence context; exact coarse VFE identities are derived in the project.

pdfs.title: Universal Connections: The Local Problem
pdfs.scope: Studies local realization by universal connections. The result does not by itself construct the program-specific normalized physical model.

pdfs.title: Markov Chains and Mixing Times: Retrieved Author Text
pdfs.scope: The retrieved title pages identify the three authors but not the edition date. Used for Markov-chain background, with version uncertainty retained.

pdfs.title: Two Problems with Variational Expectation Maximisation for Time-Series Models
pdfs.scope: Author-hosted preprint corresponding to the cited 2011 chapter. It motivates careful treatment of temporal correlations and variational approximations.

pdfs.title: Graph Coarsening with Message-Passing Guarantees
pdfs.scope: NeurIPS proceedings PDF of the source also retained through arXiv:2405.18127.

pdfs.title: Graph Reduction with Spectral and Cut Guarantees
pdfs.scope: JMLR version of the source also retained through arXiv:1808.10650.
